releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 289: Private Locker Pattern, Fingerprint, removal and Lock Off/On controls are grouped outside the entire Locker screen under the Private Locker button in Me. Selecting a control opens the Locker authentication before applying the change. Locker writing/search and saved data remain unchanged.
